Managing Gas and Bloating
Occasional intestinal gas is normal. Self-Care for Mild Bloating: - Avoid
chewing gum or drinking through straws, which increases swallowed air. -
Limit carbonated beverages. - Engage in light walking after meals to
encourage gas clearance.
